metadata.title: Infrastructure Management Plane Trust

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring the integrity, control, and trustworthiness of systems that provision, configure, and manage infrastructure platforms.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Infrastructure management control planes including Infrastructure-as-Code, provisioning systems, configuration management, CI/CD for infrastructure, and fleet management tooling.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Governs trust assumptions and blast radius for infrastructure management and automation control planes.

metadata.remarks: Infrastructure Management Plane Trust defines trust properties required to safely operate systems that create, modify, and destroy infrastructure platforms. This pattern exists to make automation and management-plane risk explicit, recognizing that compromise at this layer can undermine all dependent platforms simultaneously.

components.title: Infrastructure Change Authority
components.description: Restriction and governance of who or what may make authoritative changes to infrastructure state.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of valid accounts used by infrastructure management or automation systems.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong governance of identities permitted to modify infrastructure state.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Least privilege for infrastructure modification roles.

components.title: Automation Blast Radius Control
components.description: Limitation of scope and impact of automated infrastructure management actions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Execution of administrative commands or provisioning actions via compromised automation tooling.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Design of automation workflows to constrain blast radius and prevent cascading failure.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Protection against resource or change exhaustion.
Recovery and resilience planning for automation failures.

components.title: Management Plane Auditability
components.description: Visibility and attribution of actions performed through infrastructure management systems.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Impairment or bypass of logging for infrastructure management actions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Comprehensive logging and attribution of management-plane activities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Audit logging of infrastructure management actions.
Review and analysis of management-plane audit events.
